_comment: 设计稿：AI 回复里的「选项卡」（choice card）与输入框里的已选 chip。全部是注入到真实界面上的 DOM 原型（scripts/screenshots/injects/choice-card-*.js），不含产品代码——它们只用来给 docs/design/choice-cards.zh-CN.md 出样张。

choice-card-empty.note: 设计稿 A · 未选。回复末尾挂一张选项卡：标题说明这是在问下一步做什么，三个选项各带一行后果说明，右上角标注单选。整张卡只比正文宽一格，与审批卡（也是卡片）靠位置区分——它跟在正文里，不浮在输入框上方。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if(!card) throw new Error('the choice card did not render'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

choice-card-chosen.note: 设计稿 A · 已选。点一下选项，卡片留下记录（选中的行高亮），答案作为**编辑器内的 pill** 落在输入框里——和文件引用同一个原子元素。所以什么都没打字时发送键就已经可用；这是 v1 的错误：v1 把 chip 放在附件行，inputEmpty 仍为真，发送键恒灰，需求 (d) 根本不成立。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); const r=card.getBoundingClientRect(); const pill=document.querySelector('[data-mention="choice"]'); if(!pill) throw new Error('no answer pill in the editor'); const editor=document.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]'); if(!editor.contains(pill)) throw new Error('the pill is not inside the editor'); const pr=pill.getBoundingClientRect(); const er=editor.getBoundingClientRect(); if(pr.x < er.x-1 || pr.right > er.right+1) throw new Error('the pill spills out of the editor'); const f=document.querySelector('form').getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.bottom > f.top - 8) throw new Error('the card runs under the composer'); const picked=[...card.querySelectorAll('[data-choice-option]')].filter(o=>getComputedStyle(o).borderColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'); if(picked.length!==1) throw new Error(picked.length+' options look chosen'); const btn=window.__choiceSendButton(); if(btn.disabled) throw new Error('send is disabled with only a choice made — requirement (d) is broken'); const typedNodes=[...editor.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===3).map(n=>n.textContent.replace(/[\u200B\s]/g,'')).join(''); if(typedNodes) throw new Error('nothing should be typed beside the pill: '+JSON.stringify(typedNodes)); return JSON.stringify({card:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)],pill:[Math.round(pr.x),Math.round(pr.width)],sendDisabled:btn.disabled}); })()

choice-card-change.note: 设计稿 A · 改回来。pill 自带铅笔与叉：铅笔在同一处把问题重新展开（浮层贴在 pill 上方，不跳回正文），换一个选项时 pill 的文案跟着变；叉直接撤销这次选择，pill 消失、发送键跟着变灰。

steps.eval: (() => { const p=document.querySelector('[data-choice-popover]'); if(!p) throw new Error('no popover'); const r=p.getBoundingClientRect(); const pill=document.querySelector('[data-mention="choice"]').getBoundingClientRect(); const f=document.querySelector('form').getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.height<100) throw new Error('the popover is too small'); if(r.bottom > pill.top+2) throw new Error('the popover overlaps the pill it belongs to'); if(r.top < 60) throw new Error('the popover is off the top: '+r.top); if(f.bottom > window.innerHeight+1) throw new Error('the composer is off screen'); return JSON.stringify({pop:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)],pill:[Math.round(pill.top)],form:[Math.round(f.top)]}); })()

choice-card-chosen-text.note: 设计稿 A · 已选 + 补了一句话（需求 c）。pill 与文字在同一个编辑器流里，顺序就是读者看到的顺序；发送出去时先 pill 的答案、后文字（`serialize()` 按文档顺序产出），所以用户气泡里显示的就是真正发出去的内容。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const editor=document.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]'); const pill=editor.querySelector('[data-mention="choice"]'); if(!pill) throw new Error('no pill'); const visible=(editor.innerText||'').replace(/[\u200B]/g,''); if(!visible.includes('顺便把图例挪到右下')) throw new Error('the typed words are missing: '+JSON.stringify(visible)); const flow=[...editor.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===3 ? n.textContent.replace(/[\u200B\s]/g,'').length>0 : n.nodeType===1&&n.getAttribute('data-mention')); const first=flow[0]; if(!(first.nodeType===1&&first.getAttribute('data-mention')==='choice')) throw new Error('the pill must come before the typed words, got '+JSON.stringify(flow.map(n=>n.nodeType===3?'text':n.getAttribute('data-mention')))); const btn=window.__choiceSendButton(); if(btn.disabled) throw new Error('send must be enabled'); return JSON.stringify({flow:flow.map(n=>n.nodeType===3?'text':'pill'),sendDisabled:btn.disabled}); })()

choice-card-queue.note: 设计稿 · 已选的消息**进了发送队列之后**（桌面端，本地会话）。队列行今天只有纯文本：`queueDraft()` 把 `editor.getContent()` 交给面板，答案此时已经拍平成 `[接下来做哪一件？ → 重画森林图]` 这一串字，行内编辑框也只能改这串字。设计要加的是把答案作为结构化 chip 留在行里。注意 chip 本身**就是按钮**（带 chevron），不另配铅笔：这一行已经有一支"改文字"的铅笔，两支铅笔隔着几像素表示不同的事，正是本设计要消除的歧义。

steps.eval: (() => { const box = document.querySelector('[role=textbox]'); box.focus(); box.textContent = ''; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'draft cleared'; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const toggle=document.querySelector('[data-queue-toggle]'); if(!toggle) throw new Error('the queue header is not a control'); if(toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='false') throw new Error('the queue opened itself: it draws no rows until asked'); toggle.click(); return 'opened'; })()

(() => { const panel=document.querySelector('[data-send-queue]'); if(!panel) throw new Error('no queue panel'); const chip=panel.querySelector('[data-queue-choice]'); if(!chip) throw new Error('the row has no choice chip'); if(panel.querySelectorAll('[data-queue-item]').length!==1) throw new Error('the panel must hold exactly one row'); const rowEl=panel.querySelector('[data-queue-item]'); const r=chip.getBoundingClientRect(); const row=rowEl.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.width<60) throw new Error('the chip is collapsed: '+Math.round(r.width)); if(r.right>row.right+1) throw new Error('the chip overflows the row'); if(chip.tagName!=='BUTTON') throw new Error('the chip itself must be the button, not a wrapper around one: '+chip.tagName); if(chip.querySelector('button')) throw new Error('a button inside the button'); if(chip.querySelectorAll('svg').length!==1) throw new Error('the chip must carry exactly one affordance icon, got '+chip.querySelectorAll('svg').length); const label=chip.getAttribute('aria-label'); if(!label||!label.includes('更换')) throw new Error('the chip does not say it changes the choice: '+label); const edit=rowEl.querySelector('[data-queue-edit]'); if(!edit) throw new Error('the row lost its own edit-the-words pencil'); if(!(r.right < edit.getBoundingClientRect().left)) throw new Error('the chip overlaps the row pencil: '+Math.round(r.right)+' vs '+Math.round(edit.getBoundingClientRect().left)); const text=rowEl.innerText||''; if(text.includes(' → ')) throw new Error('the row still shows the flattened answer instead of a chip: '+JSON.stringify(text.slice(0,80))); if(!text.includes('顺便把图注也改成中文')) throw new Error('the typed words are missing from the row: '+JSON.stringify(text.slice(0,80))); return JSON.stringify({chip:[Math.round(r.width),Math.round(r.height),Math.round(r.right)],pencil:Math.round(edit.getBoundingClientRect().left),change:label}); })()

choice-card-queue-remote.note: 设计稿 · 已选的消息进了发送队列（**远程桌面**）。远程 composer 是宿主的 composer 的镜像，但它复用桌面的同一个 `SendQueuePanel`，所以队列行的样式、行高、铅笔与垃圾桶的位置全都是桌面端那一套——远程不需要另画一遍，只需要确认它没有因为远程样式表而走样。

steps.eval: (() => { const panel=document.querySelector('[data-send-queue]'); if(!panel) throw new Error('the remote frame has no queue panel'); const toggle=panel.querySelector('[data-queue-toggle]'); if(!toggle) throw new Error('the remote queue header is not a control'); if(panel.querySelectorAll('[data-queue-item]').length!==0) throw new Error('the remote queue draws rows before it is asked'); toggle.click(); return 'opened'; })()

(() => { const panel=document.querySelector('[data-send-queue]'); if(panel.querySelectorAll('[data-queue-item]').length<1) throw new Error('the panel holds no rows'); return JSON.stringify({rows:panel.querySelectorAll('[data-queue-item]').length}); })()

(() => { const panel=document.querySelector('[data-send-queue]'); const chip=panel.querySelector('[data-queue-choice]'); if(!chip) throw new Error('the remote queue row has no choice chip'); const rowEl=chip.closest('[data-queue-item]'); const r=chip.getBoundingClientRect(); const row=rowEl.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.right>row.right+1) throw new Error('the chip overflows the remote row'); if(chip.tagName!=='BUTTON') throw new Error('the chip must be the button here too'); if(chip.querySelectorAll('svg').length!==1) throw new Error('exactly one affordance icon expected, got '+chip.querySelectorAll('svg').length); const edit=rowEl.querySelector('[data-queue-edit]'); if(!edit) throw new Error('the remote row lost its edit pencil'); if(!(r.right < edit.getBoundingClientRect().left)) throw new Error('the chip overlaps the remote row pencil'); const ta=document.querySelector('form textarea'); if(ta && (ta.value||'').trim()) throw new Error('the remote field must stay empty'); return JSON.stringify({chip:[Math.round(r.width),Math.round(r.height)],pencil:Math.round(edit.getBoundingClientRect().left),row:[Math.round(row.width)]}); })()

choice-card-remote.note: 远程桌面 · 同一张卡。远程会话用的是宿主的 transcript 和本机的 composer，卡片由同一份 renderer 画出来，所以样式、字号、留白与本机一致（宽度跟远程输入框同宽）。远程 composer 是纯 textarea、没有 pill，所以已选项走输入框上方的 chip 行——和附件同一个槽位。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if(!card) throw new Error('the card did not render in the remote transcript'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { if(!document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) throw new Error('the frame is not dark'); const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); const r=card.getBoundingClientRect(); const form=document.querySelector('form').getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.bottom > form.top - 8) throw new Error('the card runs under the composer'); const pill=document.querySelector('[data-mention="choice"]'); if(!pill) throw new Error('no answer pill in the editor'); const bg=getComputedStyle(card).backgroundColor; if(bg === 'rgb(255, 255, 255)') throw new Error('the card kept the light surface in a dark frame'); const pbg=getComputedStyle(pill).backgroundColor; if(pbg === 'rgb(232, 240, 255)') throw new Error('the pill kept the light accent-soft in a dark frame'); return JSON.stringify({bg, pillBg:pbg, card:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)]}); })()

choice-card-implemented.note: 真实组件 · 桌面。回复末尾的 futureos-choice 围栏由 packages/markdown 解析、由 ChoiceCard.tsx 画出真正的选项卡（不再是注入原型）：问题、单选标注、三行选项与各自的后果说明。卡长在正文列里、与正文同宽。这是线程里最后一张卡，所以它是可交互态（§2）——行在 tab 序里、点下去会写进草稿；还没有选任何东西，所以发送键仍是灰的（需求 a）。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if(!card) throw new Error('the choice card did not render'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if (!card) throw new Error('the reply did not render a choice card'); const body = card.closest('[data-message-id]'); if (!body) throw new Error('the card is not inside a reply'); const rows = [...card.querySelectorAll('[data-choice-option]')]; if (rows.length !== 3) throw new Error('the card draws ' + rows.length + ' options'); if (!rows.every(row => row.getAttribute('role') === 'radio')) throw new Error('the rows are not radio rows'); if (rows.some(row => row.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'false')) throw new Error('nothing is picked, so no row may read as checked'); const state = card.getAttribute('data-choice-state'); if (state !== 'active') throw new Error('the last card in the thread must be answerable: ' + state); if (rows.filter(row => row.tabIndex === 0).length !== 1) throw new Error('a live card is a roving radio group: one row in the tab order, the rest out of it'); if (card.querySelector('[data-choice-footer]')) throw new Error('the footer may only appear after a pick'); if (!card.querySelector('[role="radiogroup"]')) throw new Error('the rows are not grouped'); const label = document.getElementById(card.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')); if (!label || label.textContent !== '接下来做哪一件？') throw new Error('the group is not labelled by the question'); if (!card.textContent.includes('单选')) throw new Error('the mode label is missing'); if (!card.querySelector('[data-choice-context]') || !card.textContent.includes('重算和补图互不依赖')) throw new Error('the card lost its context paragraph'); const column = body.querySelector('p'); const cr = card.getBoundingClientRect(), pr = column.getBoundingClientRect(); if (Math.abs(cr.width - pr.width) > 1) throw new Error('the card is ' + Math.round(cr.width) + 'px wide against a ' + Math.round(pr.width) + 'px column'); if (Math.abs(cr.left - pr.left) > 1) throw new Error('the card does not start at the column edge'); const form = document.querySelector('form').getBoundingClientRect(); if (cr.bottom > form.top - 8) throw new Error('the card runs under the composer'); if (document.body.innerText.includes('futureos-choice')) throw new Error('the fence rendered as a code block, not a card'); const submit = document.querySelector('form button[type="submit"]'); if (!submit || !submit.disabled) throw new Error('nothing is picked, so send must stay disabled — requirement (a)'); return JSON.stringify({card:[Math.round(cr.top),Math.round(cr.bottom),Math.round(cr.width)],column:Math.round(pr.width),rows:rows.length}); })()

choice-pill-implemented.note: 真实组件 · 桌面。点卡片上的「重画森林图」，答案作为编辑器内的原子 pill 落进输入框（§2 的那条：卡片与 pill 是同一个值的两个视图）。什么都没打字、只选了答案时发送键是亮的（§5.2.1，需求 d），点 pill 的叉后立刻变灰（需求 a）。pill 由产品的点击路径写入（tap 是真实的鼠标按下/抬起），不再靠注入；发送键的亮/灰同样是应用自己通过 isEditorEmpty 得出的。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if(!card) throw new Error('the choice card did not render'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const pill = document.querySelector('[data-mention="choice"]'); if (!pill) throw new Error('clicking a row wrote no answer pill'); const editor = document.querySelector('[role="textbox"][contenteditable="true"]'); if (!editor || !editor.contains(pill)) throw new Error('the pill is not inside the editor'); const pr = pill.getBoundingClientRect(), er = editor.getBoundingClientRect(); if (pr.left < er.left - 1 || pr.right > er.right + 1) throw new Error('the pill spills out of the editor'); if (pr.height < 16 || pr.height > 30) throw new Error('the pill is ' + Math.round(pr.height) + 'px tall'); if (!pr.width || pr.right > er.right) throw new Error('the pill has no room in the editor'); const typed = [...editor.childNodes].filter(node => node.nodeType === 3).map(node => node.textContent.replace(/[\s\u200B]/g, '')).join(''); if (typed) throw new Error('nothing may be typed beside the pill: ' + JSON.stringify(typed)); if (!pill.querySelector('[data-choice-action="change"]')) throw new Error('the pill has no change action'); if (!pill.querySelector('[data-choice-action="remove"]')) throw new Error('the pill has no remove action'); const card = document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); const marked = [...card.querySelectorAll('[data-choice-option]')].filter(row => row.getAttribute('data-choice-selected') === 'true'); if (marked.length !== 1 || marked[0].getAttribute('data-choice-option') !== 'forest') throw new Error('the card does not mark the picked row'); if (!card.querySelector('[data-choice-footer]')) throw new Error('the card never says the answer is waiting in the composer'); const body = card.closest('[data-message-id]'); const cr = card.getBoundingClientRect(), br = body.getBoundingClientRect(); if (cr.left < br.left - 1 || cr.right > br.right + 1) throw new Error('the card left the reply column'); const submit = document.querySelector('form button[type="submit"]'); if (!submit) throw new Error('no send button'); if (submit.disabled) throw new Error('send is disabled with an answer and no text — requirement (d) is broken'); return JSON.stringify({pill:[Math.round(pr.left),Math.round(pr.width),Math.round(pr.height)],card:[Math.round(cr.left),Math.round(cr.right)],sendDisabled:submit.disabled}); })()
